coop_dbshotgun.name: Shotgun (Double Barrel)
coop_dbshotgun.why: 2026-10-12 (dbshotgun): F = the centre of the brass bead between the muzzles, R = the top of the breech end on the centre line (both read from build/model.json, written by tools/dbs_build.py from the mesh). The eye looks over the breech along the rib between the barrels to the bead; delta = the bead this far above the breech top in the picture. LOCAL row: the shared ironsights sights.json is not edited; tools/sightrow_dbs.py writes the one row into the lane worktree's cg_adssights.h.
